upstream_kernel_references.role: porous medium / anisotropic permeability; not circular channel
mechanical, thermal and species transport coupling gates

constitutive_core.law: Newtonian scalar tau=mu*gamma_dot; tube Δp=8 mu L Q/(pi r^4) ONLY in screened regime

domain_lenses.candidate_if: single-phase Newtonian constant-viscosity straight microchannel sample with measured mu(T) and geometry
domain_lenses.rejects: UV-curing resin shear thinning, heating, phase transition, free-surface deposition or cure/gel kinetics
domain_lenses.extra_proof: rheometer vs shear rate/T; cure, flow-pressure, surface-wetting and material sequence X->Y

domain_lenses.candidate_if: only single-phase closed liquid feed channel with inlet development proof
domain_lenses.rejects: droplets entrainment, air-water two-phase mist, aerosol dispersion, unsteady wind
domain_lenses.extra_proof: nozzle droplet sizes, aerosol/deposition, weather, public safety and water chemistry

domain_lenses.candidate_if: sealed incompressible liquid line in supported acceleration and inlet regime only
domain_lenses.rejects: gas-liquid interface, cavitation, propellant settling and microgravity free-surface/slosh
domain_lenses.extra_proof: accelerations, capillarity, wetting, thermal state, verified propulsion engineering

domain_lenses.candidate_if: use existing VGK-020 Darcy permeability tensor with independent measured k, not VGK-019
domain_lenses.rejects: substitution of pipe Poiseuille for aquifer/porous vadose flow or species reaction
domain_lenses.extra_proof: saturation, medium heterogeneity, anisotropy, boundary/geospatial sources and independent observations

domain_lenses.candidate_if: reuse viscosity property and momentum-conservation source operator only
domain_lenses.rejects: using circular channel Δp law for compressible external aerodynamic drag or turbulent boundary layers
domain_lenses.extra_proof: Mach, Reynolds, Knudsen, boundary layer, gas properties, body frame and CFD/wind-tunnel validation

counterexamples.why: mu varies with shear history and wall stress is not Newtonian
Poiseuille model candidate screening not safe outside laminar regime
permeability and saturation data belong to VGK-020

optional_view: Alexandria/LightSpeed existing source-graded operator detail; no new UI/page published

approve licensed numerical provider only after ABI/version review
independently calibrate and falsify physical predictions
review ACL/DBR before any execution or public render
